title: Fine-Grained Bias Detection in LLM : Enhancing detection mechanisms for nuanced biases.

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using contrastive prompts, counterfactual data augmentation, and contextual association scoring to evaluate demographic representation and subtle disparities in model outputs.
Assessed via word embedding and sentence encoding association tests (WEAT/SEAT), contextual association scores, and counterfactual augmentation to detect nuanced disparities.
Evaluated using balanced benchmark datasets of cultural texts, conversational data, and social media to detect implicit and explicit biases across different linguistic and cultural contexts.
Evaluated by testing the model under various ideological scenarios and utilizing framing analysis on news articles and social media datasets.
